text: {"rules":[],"notes":"Part 2 of 2 of M.G.L. c. 151B, § 4 contains only provisions on age-based credit practices, employment discrimination (handicap, sexual harassment, retirement, genetic information, record-keeping), and a sexual-harassment prohibition for housing providers (subsection 18). None of these fall within the six categories (rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application/screening fees, screening restrictions on criminal history, source of income or credit, algorithmic rent setting). Subsection 18 is general anti-discrimination (sexual harassment of tenants), not a screening-criteria rule, so it is excluded."}
